title: Kitchen
subtitle: 「廚房」，究竟是哪一種烹飪空間？
description: 「廚房」，究竟是哪一種烹飪空間？

words.note: 最直接、最容易理解的替換之一，強調實際煮食、加熱和準備餐點的區域；可以是完整房間，也可以是較開放的區域。
words.example: The apartment has a compact cooking area beside the dining space.
words.exampleZh: 這個單位的用餐區旁有一個小型烹飪區。

exercises.original: The apartment has a small kitchen beside the dining table.
exercises.zh: 這個單位的餐桌旁有一個小型烹飪區。
exercises.upgrade: cooking area · 烹飪區；煮食區

options.explanation: dining room = 句子說的是煮食功能，不是用餐空間。
cooking area = 住宅中若重點是實際煮食功能區，而未必是獨立房間，cooking area 很自然。
cafeteria = 住宅內不會有 cafeteria。

exercises.original: The studio's kitchen is open to the living room.
exercises.zh: 這個開放式單位的煮食區與客廳相連。
exercises.upgrade: cooking area · 烹飪區；煮食區

options.explanation: cooking area = open to the living room 表示開放式功能區，因此 cooking area 比 room 更精確。

exercises.original: The campsite has a shared kitchen where visitors can prepare meals.
exercises.zh: 營地有一個共用煮食區，讓訪客準備餐點。
exercises.upgrade: cooking area · 烹飪區；煮食區

options.explanation: canteen = canteen 是用餐／供餐地點，不一定讓 visitors 自己煮。
cooking area = 供多人自行 prepare meals 的共享區域，用 cooking area 很自然。

words.note: 較正式、描述性，強調主要用途是處理、切配和準備食物，常見於餐飲、學校、醫院或大型設施。
words.example: Staff prepare ingredients in a separate food-preparation room.
words.exampleZh: 員工在獨立的食物準備室處理食材。

exercises.original: The hospital has a separate kitchen for preparing meals for patients.
exercises.zh: 醫院設有獨立食物準備室，為病人準備餐點。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation room · 食物準備室；備餐室

options.explanation: dining room = 病人不在此處主要用餐。
cafeteria = cafeteria 是取餐和用餐區。
food-preparation room = 醫院中專門用於備餐的獨立房間，正式可稱 food-preparation room。
canteen = 同樣不是主要備餐室。

exercises.original: Raw and cooked foods are handled in different parts of the kitchen.
exercises.zh: 生食和熟食在食物準備室的不同區域處理。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation room · 食物準備室；備餐室

options.explanation: pantry = 不適合處理生熟食流程。
dining room = 不是食品處理區。
food-preparation room = 食品衛生流程強調專門備餐空間，因此這個正式描述很合適。

exercises.original: School meals are assembled in a large kitchen behind the serving area.
exercises.zh: 學校餐點在供餐區後方的大型食物準備室組裝。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation room · 食物準備室；備餐室

options.explanation: canteen = canteen 通常是學生用餐區。
pantry = 不是完整備餐流程空間。
cafeteria = serving area 可能屬 cafeteria，但此句說後方備餐房。
food-preparation room = behind the serving area + meals assembled 表示後場備餐房，因此 food-preparation room 最自然。

words.note: 較舊式或特定語境，常見於軍營、營地、船隻或大型工作場所，指集中煮食的地方。
words.example: Meals were prepared in the camp cookhouse.
words.exampleZh: 餐點在營地的炊事房準備。

exercises.original: Meals at the remote work camp are prepared in a central kitchen.
exercises.zh: 偏遠工作營地的餐點在中央炊事房準備。
exercises.upgrade: cookhouse · 炊事房；廚房

options.explanation: dining room = 不是用餐空間。
cookhouse = remote work camp 是 cookhouse 的典型傳統語境。

exercises.original: The soldiers collected their meals from the kitchen beside the barracks.
exercises.zh: 士兵從軍營旁的炊事房領取餐點。
exercises.upgrade: cookhouse · 炊事房；廚房

options.explanation: canteen = 可能是領餐和用餐地點，但 beside the barracks 的集中煮食房更精確是 cookhouse。
cookhouse = 軍營集中煮食設施可自然稱 cookhouse。

exercises.original: The forestry camp had a kitchen where food was cooked for all the workers.
exercises.zh: 林業營地設有一座為所有工人煮食的炊事房。
exercises.upgrade: cookhouse · 炊事房；廚房

options.explanation: cookhouse = camp + centralized cooking for workers 是 cookhouse 的自然用法。
cafeteria = 可能有用餐功能，但句子明確強調 cooked。

words.note: 主要指船舶或飛機上的廚房，屬非常具體的專門用語。
words.example: The crew prepared breakfast in the ship's galley.
words.exampleZh: 船員在船上的廚房準備早餐。

exercises.original: The ship's kitchen is located on the lower deck.
exercises.zh: 船上的廚房位於下層甲板。
exercises.upgrade: galley · 船上／飛機上的廚房

options.explanation: cookhouse = 較偏營地／大型陸上設施。
canteen = 不合船上專門廚房。
kitchenette = 未必是小型簡易廚房。
galley = ship 是最明確線索，船上廚房標準稱 galley。

exercises.original: Cabin crew prepared drinks in the aircraft kitchen.
exercises.zh: 機艙服務員在飛機廚房準備飲品。
exercises.upgrade: galley · 船上／飛機上的廚房

options.explanation: galley = 飛機上準備餐飲的空間標準稱為 galley。
pantry = 飛機上的標準術語是 galley。
commercial kitchen = 規模和功能不同。

exercises.original: The chef returned to the yacht's kitchen to prepare dinner.
exercises.zh: 廚師返回遊艇廚房準備晚餐。
exercises.upgrade: galley · 船上／飛機上的廚房

options.explanation: galley = yacht 也是船舶，因此廚房自然稱 galley。
kitchenette = 可能大小接近，但船舶術語優先是 galley。

words.note: 指設備較少、空間較小的簡易廚房，常見於酒店房間、辦公室、宿舍或小型單位。
words.example: The studio includes a kitchenette with a sink and microwave.
words.exampleZh: 這個開放式單位設有一個有洗手盆和微波爐的小廚房。

exercises.original: The hotel room has a small kitchen with a microwave and sink.
exercises.zh: 酒店房間有一個配備微波爐和洗手盆的小廚房。
exercises.upgrade: kitchenette · 小廚房；迷你廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = hotel room + microwave + sink 是典型 kitchenette。
commercial kitchen = 不合酒店客房。
pantry = 不一定有烹飪設備。

exercises.original: The office has a tiny kitchen for making drinks and reheating food.
exercises.zh: 辦公室有一個小廚房，用來沖飲品和翻熱食物。
exercises.upgrade: kitchenette · 小廚房；迷你廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = 設備有限、只作基本飲食準備的 office kitchen，kitchenette 最自然。
pantry = 若有 microwave/reheating 功能，kitchenette 更準確。

exercises.original: The studio apartment includes a compact kitchen in one corner.
exercises.zh: 這個開放式單位的一角設有迷你廚房。
exercises.upgrade: kitchenette · 小廚房；迷你廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = studio apartment 中 compact kitchen 是 kitchenette 的典型用法。
pantry = 不一定有完整基本烹飪功能。

words.note: 指為大量餐點、活動或機構供餐而設的專業廚房。
words.example: The venue has a catering kitchen for large events.
words.exampleZh: 場地設有供大型活動使用的餐飲廚房。

exercises.original: The event venue has a large kitchen for preparing food for hundreds of guests.
exercises.zh: 活動場地設有大型餐飲廚房，可為數百名賓客準備食物。
exercises.upgrade: catering kitchen · 餐飲廚房；供餐廚房

options.explanation: catering kitchen = hundreds of guests + event venue 表明大型供餐用途，因此 catering kitchen 最精確。
pantry = 不是大量製餐空間。
cookhouse = 可集中煮食，但 event venue 更自然用 catering kitchen。

exercises.original: Food for conferences is prepared in the hotel's main kitchen.
exercises.zh: 會議餐點在酒店主要餐飲廚房準備。
exercises.upgrade: catering kitchen · 餐飲廚房；供餐廚房

options.explanation: catering kitchen = conference catering 是專業大量供餐，因此 catering kitchen 很自然。

exercises.original: The hall includes a kitchen designed for weddings and large functions.
exercises.zh: 禮堂設有一個為婚宴和大型活動而設的餐飲廚房。
exercises.upgrade: catering kitchen · 餐飲廚房；供餐廚房

options.explanation: catering kitchen = weddings and large functions 是典型 catering kitchen 用途。

words.note: 指餐廳、外賣、食品企業等用於商業食品製作的專業廚房，通常須符合特定衛生和設備標準。
words.example: The bakery operates from a licensed commercial kitchen.
words.exampleZh: 這間麵包店在一個持牌商業廚房內營運。

exercises.original: The bakery operates from a licensed kitchen that meets food-safety standards.
exercises.zh: 這間麵包店在符合食品安全標準的持牌商業廚房營運。
exercises.upgrade: commercial kitchen · 商業廚房；專業廚房

options.explanation: commercial kitchen = licensed + food-safety standards + bakery operation 是 commercial kitchen 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The start-up rents a shared kitchen to produce meals for delivery.
exercises.zh: 這間初創公司租用共用商業廚房製作外送餐點。
exercises.upgrade: commercial kitchen · 商業廚房；專業廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = 不適合商業 meal production。
catering kitchen = 也接近，但 delivery business 更一般地屬 commercial kitchen。
commercial kitchen = 為食品業務生產外賣餐點，需要專業 commercial kitchen。

exercises.original: Local regulations require the sauce to be produced in an approved kitchen.
exercises.zh: 當地規例要求這款醬汁必須在獲批准的商業廚房生產。
exercises.upgrade: commercial kitchen · 商業廚房；專業廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = 通常不符合商業生產規格。
home kitchen = 若規例要求 approved commercial site，home kitchen 不合。
cookhouse = 不合食品企業法規語境。
commercial kitchen = regulations + approved + product manufacturing 指向 commercial kitchen。

words.note: 餐飲和專業廚房語境常用，指主要用來處理食材、切配和前期準備的區域。
words.example: Vegetables are washed and chopped in the prep kitchen.
words.exampleZh: 蔬菜在備餐廚房清洗和切碎。

exercises.original: Vegetables are washed and chopped in a separate kitchen before cooking begins.
exercises.zh: 蔬菜在正式烹調前於獨立備餐廚房清洗和切碎。
exercises.upgrade: prep kitchen · 備餐廚房；準備廚房

options.explanation: dining room = 不是備料地點。
kitchenette = 不一定專門作大量備料。
prep kitchen = washed and chopped before cooking 是典型 prep 工作，因此 prep kitchen 最自然。

exercises.original: The restaurant uses a small second kitchen for preparing ingredients.
exercises.zh: 餐廳使用第二個小型備餐廚房處理食材。
exercises.upgrade: prep kitchen · 備餐廚房；準備廚房

options.explanation: kitchenette = 可能設備簡單，但用途專門是 prep。
prep kitchen = 第二個空間專門 preparing ingredients，最精確是 prep kitchen。

exercises.original: Desserts are assembled in the prep kitchen away from the hot cooking line.
exercises.zh: 甜點在遠離熱烹調線的備餐廚房組裝。
exercises.upgrade: prep kitchen · 備餐廚房；準備廚房

options.explanation: pantry = 未必有完整工作台和備料設備。
kitchenette = 不是餐廳專業分工語境。
prep kitchen = away from the hot cooking line 表示廚房內功能分區，因此 prep kitchen 很自然。

words.meaning: 烹飪工作區；料理工作空間
words.note: 較現代、描述性，強調廚房作為進行烹飪工作的功能空間，常見於設計、教育或專業培訓語境。
words.example: The school redesigned the room as a shared culinary workspace.
words.exampleZh: 學校把房間重新設計成共用烹飪工作空間。

exercises.original: The training centre converted the room into a kitchen for student chefs.
exercises.zh: 培訓中心把房間改造成供廚藝學生使用的烹飪工作空間。
exercises.upgrade: culinary workspace · 烹飪工作區；料理工作空間

options.explanation: dining room = 不是教學烹飪空間。
canteen = 不是學生實作空間。
culinary workspace = 教學和實作重點下，把 kitchen 描述為 culinary workspace 很自然。
kitchenette = 規模和功能可能不足。

exercises.original: The shared kitchen gives small food businesses access to professional equipment.
exercises.zh: 這個共用烹飪工作空間讓小型食品企業使用專業設備。
exercises.upgrade: culinary workspace · 烹飪工作區；料理工作空間

options.explanation: cookhouse = 不合創業／共享空間語境。
culinary workspace = shared + professional equipment 強調工作用途，因此 culinary workspace 很合適。

exercises.original: The school designed the kitchen so several groups could cook at the same time.
exercises.zh: 學校把烹飪工作空間設計成可讓數組學生同時煮食。
exercises.upgrade: culinary workspace · 烹飪工作區；料理工作空間

options.explanation: culinary workspace = 多組學生同時實作，重點是 functional workspace，因此此說法最自然。
kitchenette = 不適合多組同時煮食。

words.note: 比 food-preparation room 更廣，可指完整房間中的一部分，也可指開放式工作區。
words.example: Raw ingredients are handled in a separate food-preparation area.
words.exampleZh: 生食材在獨立的食物準備區處理。

exercises.original: Raw meat is handled in a separate part of the kitchen.
exercises.zh: 生肉在廚房內獨立的食物準備區處理。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation area · 食物準備區；備餐區

options.explanation: pantry = 不一定是 food handling 區。
food-preparation area = 食品安全下把 raw meat 分區處理，food-preparation area 最精確。

exercises.original: The kitchen includes a clean section for making sandwiches and salads.
exercises.zh: 廚房設有一個乾淨的食物準備區，用來製作三文治和沙律。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation area · 食物準備區；備餐區

options.explanation: food-preparation area = 完整 kitchen 內部的一個 specific prep zone，最自然是 food-preparation area。

exercises.original: Employees must wash their hands before entering the kitchen area where ingredients are handled.
exercises.zh: 員工在進入處理食材的食物準備區前必須洗手。
exercises.upgrade: food-preparation area · 食物準備區；備餐區

options.explanation: dining room = 不是 hygiene-controlled ingredient area。
food-preparation area = where ingredients are handled + hygiene rule 是 food-preparation area 的直接線索。
pantry = 不一定實際處理 ingredients。

words.note: 較口語、廣義，強調可用來煮食的空間，不一定具備完整傳統廚房格局。
words.example: The tiny cabin has only a small cooking space.
words.exampleZh: 這間小木屋只有一個很小的煮食空間。

exercises.original: The tiny cabin has only a very small kitchen.
exercises.zh: 這間小木屋只有一個很小的煮食空間。
exercises.upgrade: cooking space · 煮食空間；烹飪空間

options.explanation: cooking space = tiny cabin 中若只是有限煮食位置，cooking space 很自然。
dining room = 不是煮食功能。

exercises.original: The camper van includes a compact kitchen beside the sleeping area.
exercises.zh: 露營車在睡眠區旁設有小型煮食空間。
exercises.upgrade: cooking space · 煮食空間；烹飪空間

options.explanation: galley = 在某些車／船語境可用，但 camper van 一般描述用 cooking space 更自然。
cooking space = camper van 中有限的 functional area，cooking space 很貼切。

exercises.original: The shelter provides a basic kitchen where residents can heat simple meals.
exercises.zh: 收容所提供基本煮食空間，讓住戶翻熱簡單餐點。
exercises.upgrade: cooking space · 煮食空間；烹飪空間

options.explanation: kitchenette = 也接近，但若設備是否完整不明，cooking space 更中性。
cooking space = 只需能 heat simple meals 的基本功能區，用 cooking space 最自然。

words.note: 餐廳或酒店語境中常指顧客看不到、實際進行備料和烹調工作的廚房後場。
words.example: Most of the food is prepared in the back kitchen.
words.exampleZh: 大部分食物都在後廚準備。

exercises.original: Most dishes are prepared in the kitchen behind the dining area.
exercises.zh: 大部分菜式都在用餐區後方的後廚準備。
exercises.upgrade: back kitchen · 後廚；後場廚房

options.explanation: dining room = 是前場用餐區。
back kitchen = behind the dining area 明確是餐廳後場廚房，因此 back kitchen 很自然。

exercises.original: Guests can see the open counter, but the main cooking happens in the kitchen at the back.
exercises.zh: 客人可以看到開放式櫃檯，但主要烹調在後方廚房進行。
exercises.upgrade: back kitchen · 後廚；後場廚房

options.explanation: back kitchen = 與 visible open counter 對比，實際主要煮食區就是 back kitchen。
kitchenette = 不合 restaurant main cooking。

exercises.original: Orders are sent electronically from the dining room to the kitchen.
exercises.zh: 訂單從飯廳以電子方式傳送到後廚。
exercises.upgrade: back kitchen · 後廚；後場廚房

options.explanation: pantry = 不是處理 orders 的烹飪區。
back kitchen = dining room 與實際烹調後場形成對比，back kitchen 最精確。
cookhouse = 不合餐廳前後場語境。

falseSynonyms.zh: 飯廳不等於廚房 dining room 是吃飯的地方；kitchen 是準備和烹調食物的地方。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Meals are prepared in the kitchen and eaten in the dining room.

falseSynonyms.zh: 食品儲藏室不等於廚房 pantry 主要用來儲存食物、餐具或用品；通常不是主要煮食空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pantry stores food and supplies; a kitchen is used for cooking.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐廳空間不等於廚房 cafeteria 是人們取餐和用餐的地方；食物通常在另一個 kitchen 裡準備。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cafeteria serves diners, while a kitchen prepares the food.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐廳不等於廚房 restaurant 是整個餐飲場所；kitchen 只是其中負責備餐和烹飪的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A restaurant contains a kitchen, but the two words are not equivalent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 焗爐只是廚房設備之一 oven 是烹飪設備；kitchen 是包含多種設備和工作區的空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An oven is one appliance found in a kitchen.

falseSynonyms.zh: 完整廚房與小廚房不同 kitchenette 通常較小、設備較少；kitchen 可以是完整、設備齊全的房間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A kitchenette may have only basic appliances, while a full kitchen usually has more facilities.

falseSynonyms.zh: 烹飪區與儲物區不同 kitchen 主要用於烹調；pantry 主要用於儲藏。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Food is cooked in the kitchen and stored in the pantry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 廚房與食堂不同 canteen 通常是員工、學生等用餐的地方；kitchen 是準備食物的地方。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The canteen is where people eat; the kitchen is where meals are prepared.
